tools.name: partnerstack_list_partnerships
tools.description: List the partnerships of your program: the partners who joined it, with their keys, status and groups. Use it first to find a partnership_key. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_get_partnership
tools.description: Get one partnership by its key or unique identifier: partner, status, group and tags.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers your program has recorded, with their partner and creation time. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by its customer key: partner, email, name and metadata.

tools.name: partnerstack_create_customer
tools.description: Create one customer under a partner in your program. The customer is not linked to a referral click. Use partnerstack_get_customer to check it afterwards.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_leads
tools.description: List leads: introductions that partners submitted to your sales team. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by its key: partner, status, amount, stage and fields.

tools.name: partnerstack_create_lead
tools.description: Create one lead for a partner: a new introduction to your sales team. external_key must be unique for the lead in your system. Use partnerstack_get_lead to check it.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_deals
tools.description: List deals: sales opportunities that resellers and partners share with you. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_get_deal
tools.description: Get one deal by its key: partner, status, amount and stage.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_transactions
tools.description: List transactions: payments PartnerStack recorded for your customers. Read only. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_rewards
tools.description: List rewards: commissions owed to partners, with amount, status and the transaction they came from. Read only. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_actions
tools.description: List actions: events that partners or customers took and that PartnerStack recorded (for example a sign-up). Read only. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_groups
tools.description: List the partner groups of your program (for example tiers or regions). Read only. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_partnership_links
tools.description: List the referral links of one partnership. Read only. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_products
tools.description: List the products of your customers, with the partner and click that brought them. Read only. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: partnerstack_get_customer · Public sink: partnerstack_get_customer, partnerstack_list_deals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: partnerstack_get_customer · Public sink: partnerstack_get_customer, partnerstack_list_deals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
